entities.summary: Virasat-e-Khalsa is a museum of Sikhism, located in the town of Anandpur Sahib, and is close to the Takht Kesgarh Sahib, located in the state of Punjab, India. The museum celebrates 500 years of Sikh history and the 300th anniversary of the birth of Khalsa, based on the scriptures written by the tenth and last of Sikhism's gurus, Guru Gobind Singh. Tourists and pilgrims visit.
